title: The inbox is a single list, newest first, 50 at a time with Load more
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • 60 notifications addressed to you (enough to exceed one page of 50), from notes a second user wrote on a work order.
  • One note whose notification you received has been deleted.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Inbox tab and confirm it is one list with no second view, archive or grouping.
  2. Read the order of the notifications.
  3. Count how many load at first, then use Load more below the list.
  4. Confirm the notification for the deleted note is not shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Inbox tab is a single list - no second view, no archive, no grouping (the tab strip sits around the list, not inside it).
  • The list shows the notifications addressed to you whose note has not been deleted, newest first.
  • The inbox loads 50 notifications at a time; while a full page of 50 has come back, a Load more action below the list fetches the next 50.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “The Inbox tab is a single list. It has no second view, no archive and no grouping. The tab strip described in Story 5 sits on the page around it, not inside the list.”
  • S1-R5: “The list shows the notifications addressed to the user whose note has not been deleted.”
  • S1-R13: “Notifications are listed newest first.”
  • S1-R14: “The inbox loads 50 notifications at a time.”
  • S1-R15: “While a full page of 50 has come back, a Load more action below the list fetches the next 50.”
